exercises.name: Standing band shoulder external rotation — elbow at side
aliases: Standing band external rotation at side
Single-arm band external rotation at side

corrective_targets.selection_basis: Coach-documented external-rotation control or strength deficit, with this variant selected after assessment; a category match alone does not establish suitability.

required.name: elastic_resistance_band
required.specification: Band or tubing with a secure handhold; select resistance individually.

required.name: fixed_band_anchor
required.specification: A secure attachment compatible with the band, approximately level with the working elbow; verify the setup before use.

equipment.setup_notes: Working arm is farther from the anchor. Record band identity, resistance label, grip length and starting distance for repeatable loading. This setup is a project proposal pending coach review.

instructions.setup: Stand side-on to the attachment with the working upper arm beside the trunk and elbow bent about 90 degrees.
instructions.execution: Turn the forearm outward through a comfortable arc, then resist the band as the hand returns. Keep the upper arm beside the body.
cues: Let the shoulder rotate without moving the elbow away.
common_errors: Turning the torso to move the hand.

load_tracking.notes: Record brand/model, color or rating, grip length and starting distance in the client log. Band labels are not standardized and are not equivalent to a measured mass.

programming_contexts.selection_criteria: Proposed isolated activation use within a coach-selected corrective sequence. Confirm standing tolerance, grip, pain-free movement and compatibility with documented restrictions. No OPT phase or individual client eligibility is assigned.

tempo.intent: Slow, controlled outward movement and return; exact seconds await coach selection.

dosage.notes: Reference template starts at 3 sets of 8 and progresses toward 12 as tolerated; the range is not an automatic progression rule. Coach must review dosing before use. Frequency, rest, load and RPE are not prescribed.

precautions.instruction: Stop if painful; seek the relevant clinician's guidance when pain occurs.
Exclude until the coach documents reassessment and explicitly approves reintroduction.
Honor documented motion and loading restrictions; this record does not establish rehabilitation clearance.

sources.title: AAOS OrthoInfo: Rotator Cuff and Shoulder Conditioning Program
sources.locator: Exercise 9: External Rotation; introduction and Getting Started
sources.supports: Standing band variant, target muscles, basic movement, a 3-by-8 starting template progressing toward 12, and pain/rehabilitation precautions. This is not an NASM phase prescription.

sources.title: NASM: The Corrective Exercise Continuum: A Trainer's Working Guide
sources.locator: Phase Three: Activate; Applying It, and Staying in Scope
sources.supports: Assessment-led isolated activation, emphasis on movement quality, and referral for symptoms. The assignment of this specific exercise to Activate is a PhysioData proposal.

sources.title: Delta Fitness owner rules: pain exclusions and documented restrictions
sources.supports: Owner policy on pain-history exclusion, reassessment and explicit reintroduction approval; honoring documented restrictions.

audit.notes: Agent-authored draft for the owner-approved single-variant scope. Sources are references, not copied licensed text; descriptions are original. Taxonomy, anchor setup, cues and quality criteria are project proposals pending coach review. No client prescription or assessment is included.
